# Mint Condition

[![Mint Condition at the Daring Do convention](https://static.manebooru.art/img/2020/8/19/1214411/large.png)](https://manebooru.art/images/1214411)

Mint Condition is the *fan-named* yellow unicorn stallion spotted at the Daring Do convention in *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. His shaggy dark-purple mane, patchy chin stubble, half-lidded eyes, loose olive-green T-shirt, and peppermint-candy cutie mark make him a memorable parody of an untidy conventiongoer. Image: production still from Hasbro Studios/DHX Media; archived on Manebooru.

**Name and status:** “Mint Condition” is a fandom nickname, not a verified name spoken in the show or an established Hasbro character credit. A [fan recollection](https://www.reddit.com/r/mylittlepony/comments/1lgdnuq/why_is_nopony_talking_about_how_hasbro_referenced/) attributes the nickname to a 4chan discussion and recalls “Cheeto Dust” as a rejected suggestion; that naming history is anecdotal, not independently established. No verified alternate identity. He has **no identified spoken lines or voice actor**.

**Appearances:** *Stranger Than Fan Fiction* (S6E13, 2016), and a background reappearance in *Parental Glideance* (S7E7, 2017), as catalogued in the [G4 unicorn character list](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Unicorn_ponies).

## Important moments

He has no verified dialogue, consequential decisions, or character-defining story arc; these are his two identifiable on-screen sightings:

1. **A conspicuous convention fan — “Stranger Than Fan Fiction” (S6E13).** His outfit and unkempt appearance make him an unmistakable visual joke among the Daring Do fans. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wG_zgilo5ws) (exact scene timestamp unavailable).
2. **A return to the background — “Parental Glideance” (S7E7).** The later sighting shows that his distinctive design was reused outside the convention episode. [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=W0JTIe6eYgA) (exact scene timestamp unavailable).
